name: @contractor/native-orchestrator
description: Sync orchestration (M03-T07): versioned sync envelope (protocol version, operation/device identity, scope claims, payload digest, dependency identity), server-authoritative claim revalidation, the eight typed outcomes (accepted/previously_accepted/conflict/rejected/revoked/authentication_required/dependency_blocked/retryable), bounded FULL-jitter retries with dependency ordering, single-flight drains, foreground-without-scheduler + gated background attempts, push hints as hints only. Policy layer over the M03-T03 outbox; evidence runs the REAL server service against REAL SQLite.
